newsitem.title: USA: Technology Solutions boosted by expansion.
newsitem.headline: Technology Solutions boosted by expansion.

text.p: Technology Solutions Co, reporting higher fiscal third quarter results Thursday, cited the impact of aggressive recruiting and expansion.
"We continued aggressive recruiting and expansion efforts throughout the quarter, and as of early March we reached an all-time high of 1,028 employees worldwide," said President John Kohler.
He said this was "an indication of our accomplishments in project work and new business opportunities."
Kohler said the number of project managers increased to 108 from 66 a year ago.
Throughout the third quarter, Technology Solutions managed 250 projects at 158 clients worldwide.
Technology Solutions provides technology consulting services.
